title: Hogi Ziyarat Qabool
body:
Hussain.. Hussain.. Hussain
Hussain....
Suno zawwar e hussain ibn e ali
ek mazloom ki awaaz bulati hai tumhe
aao naam tum sabke mere dil pe hai likhe aao
apne maa baap ko is paak safar par lao
kaun is darr ki ziyarat ka sharaf paata hai
jisko abbas bulata hai wohi aata hai
